_comment: Copy for the practice-quality section and table row. Hold from deploy until the app feature ships (build with: python3 scripts/build-site.py --without practice_quality). Wording rule: practice quality, how your practice went, tips. Not a clinical assessment, not a measure of recovery, not medical advice. 'Inspired by what therapists look for' only; not built or validated by clinicians.
kicker: After each activity, see how your practice went and get a tip for next time.
每次練習之後，睇下今次做得點，仲有下次嘅小提示。
move_h: Move: how you did each exercise
move_p: The camera looks at how the movement went, inspired by what therapists look for: how far it went, pace, steadiness, left and right balance, hold time and how much of the set you finished. A six-sided chart shows today's shape with last time behind it.
鏡頭會睇動作做得點，參考治療師會留意嘅地方：幅度、速度、穩定、左右平衡、維持時間，同埋做完幾多組。六角形圖表顯示今次嘅形狀，上次嘅疊喺後面。
speak_h: Speak: how the words came out
speak_p: The same idea for speaking: words heard, saying it without hints, pace, pauses, time to start and consistency across the session.
說話都係同一個諗法：聽到嘅詞語、唔使提示講得出、速度、停頓、開口要幾耐，同成節練習嘅穩定度。
tips_h: Then a tip for next time
tips_p: Bonet gives one or two friendly tips, such as "Lift a little higher on your left side" or "Take a breath before long sentences". The daily plan adapts to them.
朱古力會俾一兩個友善嘅提示，例如「左手再舉高少少」或者「講長句之前先吸啖氣」。每日計劃會跟住調整。
caveat: These are automatic measures of home practice and general practice tips. They are not a clinical assessment or medical advice.
呢啲係喺屋企練習嘅自動量度同一般練習提示，並非臨床評估或者醫療建議。
row_label: 練習質素分析，仲有下一步提示
row_bonet: Six-axis breakdown for Move and Speak, with tips
運動同說話都有六個面向嘅分析，仲有提示

Constant Therapy: Reports cover accuracy, speed and cues; difficulty adapts
報告有準確度、速度同提示；難度會調整
Tactus Therapy: Some apps email accuracy and time reports
部分 app 會電郵準確度同時間報告
Lingraphica TalkPath: Activity reports mentioned; contents not confirmed
有提到活動報告；內容未能確認
Flint Rehab: Reps against best score; no range or tempo breakdown
次數對比最佳成績；冇幅度或速度分析
